label: Product tone
description: Mean review tone on a -2..+2 scale; seller/shipping-only reviews excluded.

label: Tone vs. own baseline
description: This quarter's tone minus the mean of the prior four quarters. The pre-registered signal.

label: Review velocity
description: Review count vs. the same quarter a year earlier. A rough proxy for units sold.

label: Defect mentions
description: Share of reviews describing failures: stopped working, broke, defective, disconnects.

label: Quality-decline mentions
description: Share of reviews comparing unfavourably with an earlier version or model.

label: Price mentions
description: Share of reviews that talk about price or value, for better or worse.

label: Seller/shipping complaints
description: Share of reviews only about delivery, packaging or the seller.

label: Revenue growth
description: SEC-reported revenue vs. the same fiscal quarter a year earlier.

label: Revenue growth acceleration
description: Change in YoY growth from the previous quarter.

label: Reddit tone
description: Tone of brand and product posts and comments. Planned source: reddit.

label: Reddit mention volume
description: Posts and comments mentioning the brand or flagship products. Planned source: reddit.

label: Search interest
description: Google Trends interest for brand and flagship products. Planned source: google_trends.

label: App-store rating
description: Average new rating of the company's apps. Planned source: app_store.
